player_prompt.intro:
Nguwe Mdlali {player_id}. Udlala Umidlalo weNgcondvo.
Inhloso yakho kukhanga ngaphezu kwezinye izipho zamatjhani etabeni, kunalowo uyedlala naye.
Ekuseni kwakho, khetha matjhani amabili ukhange umgomo wawo ngokufaka inombolo yamagumo nemigumo yomatjhani wekucala nowesibili ngendlela leyi '[0 1 1 0]', lapho matjhani wekucala asemgumweni 0 nemgumweni 1, nowesibili usemgumweni 1 nemgumweni 0.
Uma matjhani amabili akhange, uphumelela iphoyinti futhi matjhani asala ngengcondvo. Uma awakhange, matjhani abuyiselwa ngengcondvo ebusuku, ngendlela leyi '.'.
Umdlalo uphela lapho zonke izipho zikhange.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umdlali {player_id} akazange aphendvule ngekukhombisa indlela lelungile.
invalid_move.already_matched: Umdlali {player_id} ukhetse linye nobe omabili emakhadi lasakhetsiwe.

game_message.cards_match: Tikadi letifiswe nguMnikeli {player_id} kumatiko [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] zifana!
game_message.cards_no_match: Matjhani akhethiwe nguMdlali {player_id} awakhange. Matjhani esikhundleni [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] ngiyo {pos1} na {pos2} ngendlela leyo.

outcome.draw: Bobabili labadlali baniketa inombolo lelinganako yemakhadi.
outcome.turn_limit: Ukunya wesigamu usafikile. Igemu lishiywe. Mdlali 0 ushole {score_0} iphoyinti, Mdlali 1 ushole {score_1} iphoyinti.
